visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing a white lace dress and a large black bow, stands against a white textured wall. She gestures with her hands and smiles at the camera. Yellow and white title cards appear at the top. (2) The scene transitions as the woman points upwards. A translucent box appears containing four numbers: 524, 212, 618, and 571. (3) The camera cuts to a close-up of the woman. A graphical overlay at the bottom highlights the number 524, followed by a 'Wealth Index: 60' score accompanied by gold coin icons. (4) The visual changes as she points again, and the highlight shifts to the number 212. A graphic shows 'Wealth Index: 80' with more gold coins. (5) Another cut shows the woman with a thumbs-up. The number 618 is highlighted with 'Wealth Index: 90' and a pile of coins. (6) The final number, 571, is highlighted. The screen fills with festive confetti and 'Wealth Index: 100' appears. (7) The woman concludes by pointing towards the bottom, where a final list of all numbers and their corresponding scores is displayed.
